title: Deliver the Decision Context Optimizer
description:
## Scope

Turn labeled candidate data into reproducible fixed-global or target-conditioned context policies. Optimize on development labels and freeze the result before scoreboard evaluation.

## Definition of done

Deterministic baselines, selection guards, context budgets, development search, and reloadable policy artifacts operate through one provider-neutral API.
